sisi.depan: A distant, massive hexagonal viewport in the far wall reveals a brightly glowing energy core where numerous thick pipes converge from all directions.
sisi.kanan: A long heat exchanger unit with large, dark metallic fins covers the wall, emitting a shimmering haze from its upper vents next to a straight metal staircase.
sisi.belakang: Behind the camera position is a huge, sealed circular blast door with a complex central locking wheel, flanked by two recessed equipment alcoves.
sisi.kiri: Three towering cylindrical condensation tanks with frosted surfaces line the wall, interconnected by a metal spiral staircase that winds up to a higher platform.

tengah: A wide catwalk with a floor of intricate woven-pattern metal grating runs alongside a horizontal pipe several meters in diameter, which has a single large, red valve wheel, all positioned above a lower floor level.
atas: Far overhead, the high ceiling is a structural grid of interlocking beams supporting clusters of suspended amber light panels and a dense network of smaller service conduits.
